findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_help" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the All4Clinic help center (step-by-step guides in Brazilian Portuguese) for how to do something in the system: scheduling, patients, medical records, quotes, finance, inventory, team, WhatsApp. Returns up to 3 guides with title, link and the most relevant passage. Use read_help_article for t" → after: "Search the All4Clinic help center (step-by-step guides in Brazilian Portuguese; English keywords like 'appointment' or 'inventory' work too) for how to do something in the system: scheduling, patients, medical records, quotes, finance, inventory, team, WhatsApp. Returns up to 3 guides with title, li"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
